parameters.children: Supplies the child widgets in reading order.
parameters.size: Selects the size of the component.
parameters.orientation: Arranges the card’s content horizontally or vertically.
parameters.onPressed: Handles activation when the component is interactive.
parameters.selected: Indicates whether the item is selected.
parameters.style: This card's own look, slot by slot, over the card theme.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.
